::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** 14 May 1866  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55386 (1) P. 48
:::

Dear Madam,

[I](people/person_379.qmd) have today paid to your credit with [Hoare &amp; Co](organizations/other_169.qmd) - £200 – as arranged for the [“Dove”](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd).

[Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd) has just left, and he asked me to say that a copy has been today sent to [Lt. Col. Hall](people/person_2429.qmd). I am glad to say that we have had a very good start

Yours faithfully

Geo Lillie [Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Miss Yonge

&nbsp;
